title: land fast-forwards an orchestrator checkout that holds only unpushed item-file commits by rebasing them onto origin/main
goal: Retrospective of SP-avwlotax: the orchestrator committed an item-file edit (links on ST-q5r6e3nu) between landings; the next land (ST-jv27pfin) pushed and then left orch/s-avwlotax 5 commits behind origin/main ('Not possible to fast-forward'), so the orchestrator rebased and pushed by hand before the next claim. land rebases a clean checkout whose only commits beyond origin/main change item files onto origin/main after its push (or names the one command to run), so the next claim starts from the pushed main.
notes: Merged from ST-vybjfqvj “land leaves a host's local main in step with origin/main after it pushes (second-project run)” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: fast_forward_start (bl_land.py:1614) leaves local main behind when it holds unpushed commits. The same fault hit the kb at SP-avwlotax and is filed as ST-22oykpr5. Absorb: name the divergence before the push, and never push the whole local HEAD history. Its goal: After land pushes in a project whose local main holds commits not yet on origin, local main is fast-forwarded or land names the divergence before its push, never after Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "_tools/tests.py", "-k", "land_fast_forwards_host_main"]}
